label: SUPPLEMENTARY DIAGNOSTIC — not part of the pre-registered protocol and cannot change the verdict
purpose: Test competing explanations for the 0% coding-context result before concluding CLAIM-E is unsupported.

diagnostics.hypothesis: The 0% coding result is an artifact of presenting a single recent tool output; real savings come from compressing OLDER conversation turns.
diagnostics.method: Six-file multi-turn coding session (read_file tool calls interleaved with assistant turns), headroom.compress(model_limit=200000).
diagnostics.conclusion: FALSIFIED. Every message was routed to a protected class. Multi-turn framing does not change the result.

diagnostics.hypothesis: Context pressure triggers compression that a large model_limit does not.
diagnostics.method: Same session with model_limit=20000 against 16,803 tokens of content.
diagnostics.conclusion: FALSIFIED. Tight context pressure produced no additional compression.

diagnostics.hypothesis: Code compression requires the optional [code] extra, which the base install omits.
diagnostics.method: pip install 'headroom-ai[code]', then re-run a single source-file tool output.
diagnostics.conclusion: FALSIFIED for the library path. The extra installs, but the router still protects recent code.

untested_configurations: headroom wrap <agent> path, which also installs Serena semantic code navigation
Kompress-v2-base prose model (HuggingFace download; 8 GB RAM machine)
fairness_note: Three competing explanations were tested and falsified before concluding that CLAIM-E is unsupported on this dataset. The untested configurations above are named rather than dismissed: the coding claim may hold on one of them, and this experiment does not rule that out.
